name: Raw Shorts
tagline: Raw Shorts is an AI video creation tool that transforms scripts and text into animated explainer videos automatically. Its AI matches keywords in the script with relevant animated scenes and characters, producing a first-cut video in seconds. Marketers and educators use it as a rapid starting point for explainer content.
